title: pvAppendArcLength
body:
## pvAppendArcLength

Deprecated alias of pvPolylineLength: ParaView 5.13 marks AppendArcLength for removal in 5.14. It runs the same vtkAppendArcLength filter, adding a point array arc_length with the distance along each polyline from its first point (0 for points of other cell types).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Use pvPolylineLength in new workflows; this identifier is expected to disappear when ParaView 5.14 is absorbed.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AppendArcLength`. Identity: `filters/AppendArcLength`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json

  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAppendArcLength",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
